content: Yesu boda madouna ꞌiheꞌaidiya
Coinega Yesu ꞌilohihilama Galili ꞌina tupwa ma ꞌigeluwa ꞌihabala Galili holaina hali tupwanega. Holainaina sanina heluwena Taibiliya.
Eeta boda madouna mulinega sitauya, weyahina ꞌina paihowa waiwaina tolohala ꞌoidiya siꞌita pwaiya.
Coinega Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao sihaneya ꞌoyai simiyatoiya.
Tutaina ꞌoina meYudiya ꞌidi Hataona Guyaina ꞌana tuta ꞌiꞌehohoya.
Yesu ꞌiꞌita lohihila ma boda madouna ꞌiꞌitediya mulinega sitautauyama, ꞌoinega Yesu Pilipi ꞌihegwaeya ꞌigwae, “Taꞌehega nata ꞌeꞌahai tagimwanedi ma boda bewa taheꞌaidi?”
Hesilala bewa ꞌoinega Pilipi ꞌitohoya, ma hesi Yesu ꞌisanapu nugeteya toꞌaha nata ꞌipaihowa.

Ma Pilipi Yesu ꞌihegwaeya ꞌigwae, “Boda bewa madou hedadena, ma ꞌeguma tu handeledi kina ꞌoinega beledi tagimwanedi weyahidi, bwagana nata ꞌiꞌiuna ꞌiꞌiuna siꞌai, ma hesi nata geyaꞌabwa mabwaiyadi sowasowahidi.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌana tomuliya ꞌaigeda wete Yesu ꞌihegwaeya ꞌigwae,
“Gwama ꞌaigeda yalobeya ꞌana beledi nima ꞌaiꞌaigeda, ma wete ꞌana silahana ꞌeluwa. Ma boda mabwaiyadi geya sowasowahidi.” Tomuliyaina sanina Andulu, Saimoni Pita tasina.

Muliyetega Yesu ꞌana tomuliyaedi ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Tomota mabwaiyadi wahegwaedi ma modumoduwa simiya ꞌalatutu.” Weyahina ꞌasainaina ꞌoina modumodu ꞌana ꞌasa, ꞌoinega mabwaiyadi modumodu ꞌoina simiya toiya, loheloheyaedimo ꞌadi baibaiwa gide paibi tausani.

Muliyetega Yesu beledi ꞌiꞌewediya ma weyahidi ꞌigwae helauwa Yehoba ꞌoina, ꞌabwa muliyetega tomotaedi simiyatoiya ꞌiheguyaiyediya ma silahanedi wete gide ꞌoidiya ꞌipaihowa ꞌesediya. Coinega mabwaiyadi siꞌaiya ta sowasowahidi, simwausuwa.
Simwausuwa, ta Yesu ꞌana tomuliyaedi ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Beledi ꞌana tupwa mabwaiyana wasiwa heꞌautedi, sahena ꞌeta toꞌehina wete wamudamudali.”
Coinega belediyedi mugumugudi sisiwa heꞌautediya ma boha tuwelo ꞌadi baibaiwa silohemahediya.
Cigumwala ma bodaedi Yesu ꞌina paihowa waiwaina ꞌana ꞌilaꞌilala siꞌiteya ma sigwae, “Tauna tuwa bewa palopitainaina tauna ꞌabehega gogo gabulena ꞌoina ꞌitauyama.”
Eeta Yesu tomotaedi ꞌisanapudiya ꞌabehega nata siꞌabiyahi ma ꞌoidiya ꞌihekini. Ma hesi Yesuina geya nuwana, ꞌoinega ꞌiboinamo ꞌilohihila ꞌoyai.
Yesu ꞌina tauya hola tabwanega
Coinega lahilahiyega ꞌana tomuliyaedi sidobiya Galili holaina gadowaina ꞌoina,
ma ꞌidi waga ꞌoina sigeluwa ma sihahabala Kapaneumi, ma niꞌu ꞌawawa ꞌiguguyouwa. Eeta Yesu geya ꞌitauya ꞌoidiya.
Coinega sihahabala ma niꞌuwa yaumai ma bagodu madouna silobeya.
Tutaina ꞌoina sihadobiya niꞌu gamwagamwana, ꞌabwa muliyetega Yesu siꞌiteya hola tabwanega ꞌitautauyama ꞌidi waga deina. Beno ꞌoina simatauta.
Ma ꞌiyamo Yesu ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae. “Sahena wamatamatauta, taugu tuwa.”
Coinega tomuliyaedi Yesu sidoꞌoya wagai, ma tutaina ꞌoina sisohota ꞌasaina silagalaga ꞌoina gadowaina.
Yesu tauna ꞌeꞌahai moisa tomota yawasida weyahina

Gona ꞌiꞌadaleya ma bodaedi taudi Galili holaina hali tupwanega simiyamiya, sisanapuya ꞌabehega boi Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao ꞌidi waga ꞌaigeda tuwa ꞌoinega sigeluwa. Ma hesi ꞌidi lohihila ꞌoina tomuliyaedi siboidimo sigeluwa wagai ta sitauya, ma Yesu geya mahetediu sigelu.
Ma ꞌiyamo waga tupwadi Taibiliya ꞌoinega sitauyama gadowaina ꞌoina boi Yesu boda beledi ꞌoinega ꞌiheꞌaidiya, tutaina belediyedi ꞌiꞌahwa bwebweꞌanediya Yehoba ꞌoina.
Ma bodaedi Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao sibesa ꞌasaediya, ꞌoinega wagaedi ꞌoidiya sigeluwa, ma sihabala Kapaneumi ꞌoina Yesu sibesebese.
Muliyetega Galili holaina hali tupwega silobeya, ma sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Cinapwana, tolahisa ꞌuhabalama?”
Coinega Yesu tomotaedi ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Yagwae moisa ꞌoimiya, belediyedi ꞌoidiyega yaheꞌaigomiya ma wamwausuwa ꞌoinega bewa wabesebesegau, geya ꞌigu paihowa waiwaidi ꞌadi ꞌilaꞌilalaina weyahina.

Coinega bewa tuwa yahegwaegomi, sahena ꞌeꞌahai gumwagumwalidi weyahidi wapaipaihowa, ma hesi ꞌeꞌahai yawasimi miyamiya hatayana weyahidi wapaihowa. Ceꞌahainaina bewa weyahina yahehegwaegwae. Loheyaiguina taugu nata yaꞌebwaegomi. Weyahina Tamagu ꞌina paihowa bewa weyahina ꞌihesumanegauma ma yapaihowadi.”
Coinega tomotaedi Yesu sihegwae hileya, “Toꞌaha nata ꞌoidiyega Yehoba ꞌina paihowa ꞌapaihowadi?”
Ma Yesu ꞌihegwae hilediya, “Yehoba ꞌina paihowaina bewa gide taugu wahemisaegauwa, weyahina tauna ꞌihesumanegauma.”
Ma wete sihegwae hileya, “To ꞌilaꞌilala nata ꞌoima ꞌupaihowa ma ꞌoinega ꞌahemisaego?

Mwalona gide tubumayao yoho ꞌawawa ꞌeꞌahainaina siꞌaiya sanina mana. Yehoba ꞌina buki ꞌoina wete gide ꞌihepwaila ꞌesa ꞌigwae, ‘Ceꞌahainaina galewega ꞌiꞌebwaediya ma siꞌaiya.’ Coinega ꞌowa mane wete ꞌino ꞌilaꞌilala ꞌupaihowa ma ꞌaꞌita.”
Ma Yesu tomotaedi ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Yagwae moisa ꞌoimiya, Mosese ꞌeꞌahainaina beno geya galewega ꞌiꞌebwaegomi, ma hesi Tamagu tauna hene ꞌeꞌahai moisaina galewega ꞌiꞌebwaꞌebwaegomi.
Ma ꞌeꞌahainaina Yehoba ꞌoinega tauna ꞌilatu pwaima baleꞌuwa ma tomota yawasidi ꞌiꞌebwaꞌebwaedi.”
Coinega taudi wete Yesu sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Cinapwana, ꞌeꞌahainaina beno sauga mabwaiyana ꞌuꞌebwaꞌebwaemai.”

Ma Yesu wete ꞌihegwaediya, “Taugu yawasimi ꞌana ꞌeꞌahai, ꞌoinega taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌeguma watauyama ꞌoiguwa, geyaꞌabwa wagomagomale. Taiyawedi wete ꞌeguma ꞌomi wahemisaegau, nata geyaꞌabwa taniꞌomi siyahayahala.
“Ma yahegwae pwaigomiya ꞌabehega waꞌita pwaigauwa, ma hesi geya wahemisaegau.
Tomotaedi taudi Tamagu ꞌiꞌebwaegauwa hesi nata ꞌoiguwa sitauyama, ma ꞌeguma sitauyama ꞌoiguwa, nata geyaꞌabwa yalolohesohesoiyedi.
Weyahina taugu galewega yasuluma geya ꞌigu nuwatuhu sabi paihowaina, ma hesi tauna ꞌihesumanegauma ꞌina nuwatuhu sabi paihowaina.

Cihesumanegauma ma ꞌigu tomotaedi ꞌiꞌebwaegauwa ꞌina nuwatuhu bewa gide ma ꞌabehega geyaꞌabwa ꞌeta taiya ꞌoidiyega yaheꞌwadalele. Ma hesi mabwaiyadi ꞌamasa ꞌoinega yada ꞌabi hetoholo hiladi tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losaloha ꞌoina.

Tamagu bewa gide wete ꞌina nuwatuhu ma ꞌabehega taiyawedi ꞌeguma taugu natunaina siꞌitegauwa ma sihemisaegauwa, nata yawasidi miyamiya hatayana siloba. Ma wete tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losaloha ꞌoina ꞌamasa ꞌoinega yaꞌabi hetoholo hiladi.”
Beno ꞌoina meYudiya Yesu ꞌina gwae sihesagoheya ma silomugiyeya ꞌina gwaeina weyahina ꞌigwae, “Taugu bewa ꞌeꞌahainaina galewega yasuluma.”
Ma siboidimo ꞌoidiya sigwae, “Loheya bewa Yosepa natuna, sanina Yesu, ꞌawa? Tamana ma sinana wete tasanapu pwaidiya, ma togidega ta ꞌigwaeya ꞌabehega tauna galewega ꞌisuluma?”
Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwae hilediya, “Sahena waboi ꞌoimiya weyahigu walolomugi.

Weyahina Tamagu ꞌihesumanegauma ma ꞌoinega taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌilisigomi ma wanaoma ꞌoiguwa, ꞌomi nata tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losaloha ꞌoina ꞌamasa ꞌoinega yaꞌabihetoho hilegomi. Ma taiyawedi ꞌeguma geya ꞌilisidima taudi nata geyaꞌabwa ꞌoiguwa sinaonaoma.

“Gwae bewa mwalo heneyage Yehoba ꞌina buki ꞌoina palopitao sileleya sigwae, ‘Tomota mabwaiyadi nata ꞌadi heꞌita Yehoba ꞌoinega siloba.’ Ma ꞌoinega taiyawedi ꞌomi Tamadai ꞌina heꞌita wahesagoheya ma wasanapudiya, ꞌomi nata ꞌoiguwa watauyama.
Ma geya ꞌeta taiya Tamadai ꞌiꞌita toho, beno tuwa yaboi, weyahina taugu ꞌoinega yasuluma.
Coinega bewa yagwae moisa ꞌoimiya ꞌeguma taiyawedi ꞌomi wahemisaegau, nata yawasi miyamiya hatayana waloba.
Taugu tuwa yawasimi ꞌana ꞌeꞌahai.
Tubumiyaowedi mwalona yoho ꞌawawa ꞌoina ꞌeꞌahai sanina mana siꞌaiya, ma ꞌiyamo geya manaina ꞌoinega yawasidi miyamiya hatayana siloba, ma hesi ꞌoinega simiyamiya ꞌana siga siꞌamasaeya.
“Ma hesi ꞌeꞌahai hauhaunaina galewega ꞌisuluma taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌeguma waꞌewa ma waꞌai, nata geyaꞌabwa waꞌamaꞌamasa.

Weyahina taugu yawasimi ꞌana ꞌeꞌahai galewega yasuluma, ma taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌeguma ꞌeꞌahainaina ꞌoiguwega waꞌai, nata yawasimi miyamiya hatayana waloba. Ceꞌahainaina beno taugu hesiyogu yaꞌebwaegomi ma waꞌai, weyahina wahigu yatagwaleya mebaleꞌu mabwaiyami yawasimi weyahina.”
Beno ꞌoina meYudiya siboidimo siheꞌoheꞌohena sigwae, “Togidega ma loheya bewa ꞌabehega hesiyona ꞌiꞌebwaegita ma taꞌai?”

Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwae hilediya, “Yagwae moisa ꞌoimiya, taugu loheyaiguina moisa, ma ꞌeguma hesiyogu geyaꞌabwa waꞌaiꞌai ma wete ꞌeguma geyaꞌabwa bweyahigu wanumanuma, nata geyaꞌabwa yawasimi miyamiya hatayaina walobaloba.

Ma hesi taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌeguma hesiyogu waꞌai ma bweyahigu wanuma, nata moisa yawasimi miyamiya hatayaina waloba, ma wete taugu ꞌabwa nata ꞌamasa ꞌoinega yaꞌabi hetoholo hilegomi tuta ꞌana ꞌebe losaloha ꞌoina.
Weyahina wahigu bewa tauna ꞌeꞌahai moisa, ma wete bweyahigu ꞌebe numa moisa.
Taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌeguma wahigu waꞌewa waꞌai ma bweyahigu wanuma, ꞌomi ꞌoiguwa wamiyamiya ma taugu wete ꞌoimiya yamiyamiya.

Tamagu tauna moisa miyamiya hatayaina ꞌihesumanegauma, tauna ꞌoinega yawasigu yaꞌewaꞌewa. Coinega taugu wete gide, ꞌeguma taiyawedi ꞌomi hesiyogu waꞌai, ꞌomi nata wete yawasimi ꞌoiguwega waꞌewaꞌewadi.

“Ceꞌahainaina bewa galewega ꞌisuluma geya gide tubumiyaowedi ꞌeꞌahainaina mwalona yoho ꞌawawa siꞌaiya. Weyahina ꞌeꞌahainaina mwalona siꞌaiya ma geya ꞌoinega yawasidi miyamiya hatayana siloba, ma hesi ꞌoinega simiyamiya ꞌana siga siꞌamasaeya. Ma hesi ꞌeꞌahaiina bewa ꞌoiguwega taiyawedi ꞌomi ꞌeguma waꞌai, nata yawasimi miyamiya hatayana waloba.”
Gwae bewa mabwaiyana ꞌihepwaila latuhediya Kapaneumi ꞌoina tutaina hada tapwalolo ꞌoina ꞌiheheꞌita.
Yawasi miyamiya hatayaina hegwaegwaeina
Ciheheꞌita, ma ꞌana tomuliyao Yesu ꞌina gwaeina sihesagoheya, ꞌoinega tupwana baibaiwadi siboidimo ꞌoidiya sigwae, “Gwae bewa ꞌana hesagoha mwauna, ꞌoinega tauda geya nuwada.”
Ma hesi Yesu nige heneyage ꞌisanapu pwaiya ꞌabehega ꞌana tomuliyaowedi gwae bewa weyahina silolomugi. Coinega ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Gwae bewa weyahina ma ꞌabehega waguipaila?
Taugu loheyaiguina moisa ma togidega ꞌeguma waꞌitegau yahane ꞌasainaina mwalona ꞌoinega yasuluma?

Yehoba Yaluyaluwana ꞌiboinamo yawasimi ꞌana toꞌebwaya, ma hesiyage wahimi geya ꞌeta wete ꞌina lema ꞌoimiya. Cigu gwaeyedi yaꞌebwaya pwaigomiya ma ꞌoidiyega yawasimi Yehoba Yaluyaluwana ꞌoinega waꞌewaꞌewadi.
Ma hesiyage tupwami geya wahemisegauwa.” Gwae bewa Yesu ꞌiꞌinanediya weyahina ꞌisanapu nugeteya taiyawedi geya sihemisae, ma wete ꞌisanapuya taiya tauna ꞌabwa nata ꞌitebae ꞌana ꞌalehaowedi ꞌoidiya.
Coinega wete ꞌigwae, “Nuwatuhu bewa weyahina mwalona yahegwaegomiya ꞌabehega geya ꞌeta taiya sowasowahina ma ꞌitauyama ꞌoiguwa, ꞌeguma Tamagu geya ꞌoina ꞌitagwala.”
Bewa weyahina tomuliyaedi taudi Yesu silogwahateya ma siꞌebesineya.
Ma site tuwelowedi siboidimo simiya hila, ꞌoinega Yesu ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Comi togidega, nuwanuwami wete watauya?”
Coinega Saimoni Pita Yesu ꞌenana ꞌihemaiseya ꞌigwae, “Cinapwana, taiya nata ꞌoina ꞌatauya? Weyahina ꞌowa ꞌuboi yawasi miyamiya hatayana ꞌana gwae ꞌoiuwa ꞌimiyamiya.
Ma wete tauma ꞌahemisaegowa ꞌabehega ꞌowa Toꞌabihetenaina Yehoba ꞌoinega ꞌutauyama.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwae hilediya, ꞌigwae, “Moisa tuwa, ꞌomi wate tuwelo yahesinuwa pwaigomiya, ma hesiyage ꞌoimiyega nata ꞌaigeda Seitani ꞌina boda.”
Gwae bewa Yesu ꞌigwaeneya Yudasa weyahina, tauna Saimoni Isakaliyota natuna. Yudasaina tauna tuwa ꞌaigeda Yesu ꞌana tomuliya, ma hesi nata Yesu ꞌitebae ꞌana ꞌalehaowedi ꞌoidiya.
